title: backdafuckup
description: Backups, VM snapshots, transports, pool storage, the server and scale-out repositories of backdafuckup (metrics at /metrics).

panels.title: VMs whose last backup failed
panels.description: Last backup attempt of the VM in its job failed (last 14 days).

panels.title: Stale VMs
panels.description: Missed the job's most recent scheduled run that started at least 12 hours ago (the console's rule).

panels.title: Age of the newest restore point per VM
Snapshot duration p90 by storage
panels.description: The VM.snapshot call per VM. Above the red line (10 s) a VSS freeze cannot cover the snapshot.

panels.title: Disk-to-disk gap p90 by storage
panels.description: Time between the first and the last disk capture of a VM snapshot (XAPI snapshots disks one after another).

panels.title: Wait for other snapshots p90 by storage
panels.description: One snapshot at a time per storage: how long VMs waited for another VM's snapshot.

panels.title: Last snapshot per VM
panels.description: Since the server started.

panels.title: Guest writes held for the last snapshot
panels.description: VSS freeze or SQL Server suspend, per VM.

panels.title: Bytes read by transport (per day)
panels.description: http-export reads the whole allocated disk on every backup; nbd with CBT only the changed blocks.

panels.title: Read vs. unchanged vs. new (per day)
Read throughput by transport
panels.description: Bytes read per second of disk reading, per disk stream.

panels.title: Disks read in full by reason (per day)
Free space per storage
panels.description: Backups refuse to snapshot below Xen:MinStorageFreePercent (default 5 %).

panels.title: Disks per storage by kind
panels.description: Stands in for the LV count of LVM storages: more LVs make every snapshot slower.

panels.title: Used space and size per storage
SQL Server: age of the newest log backup
Scale-out free space
panels.description: Free space on the extents that take new chains (active, not in maintenance, online), of the size of all extents.

panels.title: Extents
panels.description: Each extent with its state (active, sealed, evacuating, maintenance, offline) and its chains.

panels.title: Source copies waiting
panels.description: Copies that moves left on their source extent because a reader still holds them or the extent is unavailable; the cleanup deletes them later.

panels.title: Bytes moved between extents (per day)
panels.description: Bytes that moves and rebalancing copied between the extents of each scale-out repository.

panels.title: Extent free space
panels.description: Free space per extent over time; rebalancing evens it out.

panels.title: Backup proxies connected
panels.description: Proxies connected now, of those that connected since the server started (bdfu_proxy_connected).

panels.title: Proxies: connected, open disks
panels.description: Per proxy: connected (1/0) and the disks the server has open through it now.

panels.title: HotAdd attach p90 by proxy
panels.description: Time to attach a snapshot's disk to the proxy VM (ReconfigVM_Task), p90 over 1 h windows.

panels.title: Array objects no session uses
panels.description: Snapshots and presentations of backdafuckup on the storage systems that no running session reads (bdfu_array_leftovers); the cleanup removes them, the alert fires after an hour.

panels.title: VM snapshot lifetime with array snapshots (p90)
panels.description: How long VM snapshots existed when their disks were read from an array snapshot (released before reading), p90 per day.

panels.title: Array snapshot duration (p90)
panels.description: Taking the array snapshot of a batch (bdfu_array_snapshot_seconds), p90 per day.

panels.title: Fallbacks and reader checks (per day)
panels.description: VMs read from their VM snapshot instead (by reason), and checks of the experimental reader against the previous restore point (passed, mismatch).

panels.title: VMs per array snapshot (average per day)
panels.description: How many VMs one array snapshot served (bdfu_array_batch_vms): more VMs per batch, fewer snapshots on the array.

panels.title: Instant recoveries running
panels.description: VMs that run from restore points on a datastore this server serves (bdfu_instant_recovery_sessions). They depend on the server until they are migrated or stopped.

panels.title: Written into overlays
panels.description: What the VMs of each instant recovery wrote (bdfu_instant_recovery_overlay_bytes), against its write limit where one was set.

panels.title: Age
panels.description: How long each instant recovery runs (bdfu_instant_recovery_age_seconds); the alert fires after a day.

panels.title: Datastore reads and writes
panels.description: What hosts read from instant recovery datastores, by source (overlay: written by the VMs, backup: restore points, zero), and what they wrote.

panels.title: NFS calls per second
panels.description: NFS 3 calls the server answered, by procedure; errors by status (bdfu_nfs_requests_total).

panels.title: NFS answer time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time to answer NFS calls, by procedure (bdfu_nfs_request_seconds). Reads of restore point data not yet cached take longest.

panels.title: Chunk reads from the cache
panels.description: Share of restore point chunks served from the memory cache rather than loaded from the repositories (InstantRecovery:CacheBytes).
